def max_flow(start, end, capacity):

    for _ in range(1):
        for i in range(total_nodes):
            parent[i] = -1
        parent[start] = start
        flow_value[start] = capacity
        q = deque()
        q.append(start)
        while q:
            node = q.popleft()
            if node == end:
                for cur in iter_path(node, start):
                    graph[parent[cur]][cur] -= flow_value[end]
                    graph[cur][parent[cur]] += flow_value[end]
                total += flow_value[end]

            for neighbor, capacity_edge in enumerate(graph[node]):
                if capacity_edge >= capacity and parent[neighbor] == -1:
                    parent[neighbor] = node
                    flow_value[neighbor] = min(capacity_edge, flow_value[node])
                    q.append(neighbor)
    return total

def iter_path(node, start):
    while node != start:
        yield node
        node = parent[node]
    yield start
